snippet.title: Tekken 5 Version 5.0 real arcade Kazuya Mishima gameplay Namco System 256 HD 60FPS
snippet.description:
Real arcade hardware recorded using the Elgato Camlink 4K and the OSSC. 1080p60 FPS.

This is the first revision of Tekken 5 that was released in arcades in 2004. Has the yellow life bars and the blue spot lights in the background. This version of the game is pretty difficult, certain characters are pretty unbalanced. Overall, good game. The PlayStation 2 version was based on this revision. Looks better than the PlayStation 2 port. The way to upgrade or downgrade to either 5.0 or 5.1, is to change the disc. However, the Japanese and American/World versions of the game are region locked due to the Japanese version which uses Tekken-Net. The 5.0 disc (black lettering) is not region locked and can be used with Japanese or American/World dongles. The 5.1 discs are region locked. Red lettering for the Japanese version and blue lettering for the American/World version. The disc does not unlock all the characters like the Soul Calibur 246 games do, your dongle is what unlocks them or else you’ll have to wait for them to be time released. My dongle version is TE52 Ver.B2  World version.

Game: TEKKEN 5.0 VER.B2 (2004)

Arcade System: NAMCO SYSTEM 256

*NOTE: This game play is only for entertainment purposes. Not intended as skill based game play!
